hook.text: Most AI phone agents are a black box you rent by the minute. This one is a pipeline I own.

xfer.text: Safety advice first. Then a live hand-off to a person. The bot leaves, the call stays up.

cta.text: Want your own voice stack, not a rented one? Let's build it.

call1.speaker: ana
call1.text: Hi Sam, my bathroom faucet is dripping constantly. Can someone come tomorrow afternoon?

call1.speaker: sam
call1.text: Tomorrow afternoon we have two to four PM and four to six PM. Which works best?

call1.speaker: ana
call1.text: Two to four, please. I'm at 41 Laurel Drive.

call1.speaker: sam
call1.text: Your visit is booked for tomorrow, two to four PM, with an eighty-nine dollar call-out fee.

call2.speaker: marcus
call2.text: This is Marcus. A pipe burst in my basement and water is spraying everywhere!

call2.speaker: sam
call2.text: If you can reach it safely, shut off the main water valve now. I'm connecting you to our on-call technician.

call2.speaker: twilio
call2.text: Connecting you to our on-call team now. Please stay on the line.
